active_work_package.title: Continuous Operations and the expansion streams as a reference page, rendered from PLAN-001 sections 8 and 11 - issue #199
active_work_package.objective: Resolve ticket #170 on the Guide v2 map: decide that Continuous Operations and the eight expansion streams are a reference page, not an overview section, and write reference/continuous-operations.html rendered from PLAN-001 sections 8 and 11 cell for cell, with the loop read onto the Operate and Learn stages, the entry condition and decision owner per stream, the two epics the previous plan placed after finance carried into E1 and E2 as their first items, and a limits section; bind the page to the plan with a test; link it from the overview's Continuous Operations row and the P3 manual's After section; name it in README and PLAN-001 section 8.
